premise: After a night of rain Badger finds mushrooms everywhere, and Mushroom is delighted to have so many new friends.
inspiration: The magic porridge pot (Grimm), turned: overnight abundance that is lovely, not a problem, and the lonely one gets a family.
lesson: The world can surprise you with new friends overnight.

en-US.title: Mushrooms After Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 10s} All night long, the rain fell on the forest, soft and steady. {sfx:night-rain solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} In the morning, along trotted {badger:enter} Badger, hungry for breakfast. {badger:face happy} [curious] What's under here? {badger:live} He sniffed the wet ground, dug with his front paws, pushed his nose into the hole… and popped up with earth on his nose. {badger:face surprised} [gasps] {mushroom:enter} Mushrooms! Everywhere he looked! Yesterday there had been only one little mushroom in the meadow. {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:hop} Now she had a whole family! {badger:hop} Of course, said Badger. After a night of rain, mushrooms {sfx:pops} pop, pop, pop up! Slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail crawled over to see. But the little mushroom was so excited… {mushroom:live} ah… ah… ACHOO! A puff of glittery dust! {snail:live hold} Snail pulled himself deep into his shell. {frog:enter} Frog came hopping and {frog:wobble} giggled. [whispers] It's only a sneeze! {snail:live resume} Slowly, Snail peeked out and looked around. {snail:face happy} [happily] Mushrooms everywhere, {all:hearts} all saying good morning.

es-ES.title: Setas después de la lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.6 10s} Toda la noche llovió sobre el bosque, plic, ploc, suave y sin parar. {sfx:night-rain solo} {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} Por la mañana llegó trotando {badger:enter} Tejón, con hambre de desayuno. {badger:face happy} [curious] ¿Qué habrá aquí debajo? {badger:live} Olfateó la tierra mojada, escarbó con las patas, metió el hocico en el agujero… y asomó con tierra en la nariz. {badger:face surprised} [gasps] {mushroom:enter} ¡Setas! ¡Por todas partes! Ayer solo había una seta pequeñita en el prado. {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:hop} ¡Ahora tenía una familia entera! {badger:hop} Claro, dijo Tejón. Después de una noche de lluvia, las setas {sfx:pops} ¡pop, pop, pop!, salen por todas partes. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol a mirar. Pero la setita estaba tan emocionada… {mushroom:live} ah… ah… ¡ACHÍS! ¡Una nubecita de polvo brillante! {snail:live hold} Caracol se metió bien dentro de su concha. {frog:enter} Rana llegó saltando y {frog:wobble} se rio. [whispers] ¡Solo es un estornudo! {snail:live resume} Despacio, Caracol asomó la cabeza y miró a su alrededor. {snail:face happy} [happily] Setas por todas partes, {all:hearts} dándole los buenos días.

night-rain.prompt: steady gentle rain falling on a forest at night, soft and calm

pops.prompt: three soft, quick, bubbly cartoon pops, like little mushrooms springing up out of the ground
